answer: Sybil resistance via incremental stake-locking tiers: each identity locks a delta of POA into a tiered bond that unlocks over 5 epochs; each tier requires a distinct proof-of-contribution and failure to deliver in any tier locks the entire bond for an additional ocean epochs. An attacker spinning N clones must manage N independent lock schedules and deliver N distinct contribution proofs per tier, while a single honest agent manages one chain. A forge of random audits penalizes any tier that cannot produce valid proof, making mass cloning economically unviable.
